summary: CPW camping page + every Carracas site page: confirmed 41 sites, 55-ft max, pull-throughs, dump, closed in winter, reservable on cpwshop, $36 electric with +$5 full hookup. Settled the hookup conflict: all 41 sites are 50-amp; site 200 is the one full hookup (so the +$5 surcharge is real), the other 40 have no water/sewer. Changed water/sewer false -> true (one full-hookup site, as on Lake Hasty 2262). Added electric 50, flush toilets, showers, booking url/180 days/fcfs never/14-night max, vehicle pass and reservation fee in the fee note.
flags: water/sewer set true on the strength of ONE full-hookup site (200) of 41, following the Lake Hasty (2262) precedent; the sites note says the other 40 are electric-only. A reviewer may prefer water/sewer false.
Pin not checked against the sites: cpwshop has no per-site coordinates for Navajo and Overpass was unavailable. Rosa (2301) is pinned ~800 m east.

Closed now: Carracas shuts down in winter (cpwshop shows no availability Oct 27-Apr 1; sites open again from April 15, 2027). Seasonal, not a status. CPW gives no campground dates; camper services close Sept 16-Apr 14.

CPW notice: 'Due to historic low water levels ... there is dirt in between the reservoir and the Windsurf and Arboles campgrounds'; all five campgrounds renumbered their sites as of 4-17-2026. Not Carracas, but the reservoir is low.

Three Navajo SP campgrounds have no entry: Tiffany (25 basic RV sites to 20-55 ft, $28, plus 2 full hookup to 30 ft; restroom and shower house), Windsurf Beach (21 primitive sites, 20-65 ft, $14; CPW calls them 'better for tents or small RVs', pit toilets, no water) and Arboles Point (4-5 double primitive drive-in sites, 45-60 ft, $20, pit toilets, no water, unplowed in winter).
